# The capabilities audit of a -buildmode=shared link roots every definition
# the library keeps, as deadcode does, not only its init functions. Plain go
# never writes -logos.cap, so each leg hands the linker its policy file through
# -ldflags and no other policy reaches the link. -buildmode=shared works in
# GOPATH mode only.
# Setup: none beyond -pkgdir; the library carries its own runtime closure.
# Archive members unpack relative to $GOPATH/src, the script's start directory,
# so package files are named capshared/... and the policy files $WORK/....
# RED expectation: the exported-function leg links clean when only the entry
# symbol, dynamic exports, and package init functions are roots.
[!buildmode:shared] skip
[short] skip
[!cgo] skip '-buildmode=shared requires external linking'
[!GOOS:linux] skip

env GO111MODULE=off
env GOPATH=$WORK/gopath
env CGO_ENABLED=1
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Control: a sink reached from a package init function is denied. The init
# functions are roots either way, so this proves the audit runs on the link.
! go install -buildmode=shared -pkgdir=$WORK/pkgdir -ldflags=-logos.cap=$WORK/cap-deny.json capshared/sinit
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''capshared/sinit'' reaches ''syscall\.Exec'''

# An exported function nothing in the library calls is still kept by the
# library, so the sink it reaches is denied and the function starts the chain.
! go install -buildmode=shared -pkgdir=$WORK/pkgdir -ldflags=-logos.cap=$WORK/cap-deny.json capshared/sexport
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''capshared/sexport'' reaches ''syscall\.Exec'''
stderr 'capshared/sexport\.Run\(\) +at [^ ]+\.go:\d+'
! stderr 'unauthorized_(cgo|net|reflect)'

# Control: the same library links when the policy allows exec.
go install -buildmode=shared -pkgdir=$WORK/pkgdir -ldflags=-logos.cap=$WORK/cap-allow.json capshared/sexport
! stderr 'capabilities::'

# Control: a library whose own code reaches no sink links under deny, although
# the standard library it keeps defines syscall.Exec.
go install -buildmode=shared -pkgdir=$WORK/pkgdir -ldflags=-logos.cap=$WORK/cap-deny.json capshared/sclean
! stderr 'capabilities::'

-- $WORK/cap-deny.json --
{"transitive_reflect":"allow","transitive_exec":"deny","transitive_net":"allow","main_modules":[],"cgo_allowed":[]}
-- $WORK/cap-allow.json --
{"transitive_reflect":"allow","transitive_exec":"allow","transitive_net":"allow","main_modules":[],"cgo_allowed":[]}
-- capshared/sinit/sinit.go --
package sinit

import "syscall"

func init() {
	syscall.Exec("/bin/true", nil, nil)
}
-- capshared/sexport/sexport.go --
package sexport

import "syscall"

func Run() {
	syscall.Exec("/bin/true", nil, nil)
}
-- capshared/sclean/sclean.go --
package sclean

import "syscall"

func Pid() int {
	return syscall.Getpid()
}
